facts.fact: Edison Research reported that 135 million people in the U.S. listened to a podcast monthly in 2024, per a summary cited by AdWave.
facts.quote: Edison Research reported that 135 million people in the U.S. listened to a podcast monthly in 2024, up from 47 million in 2015

facts.fact: Edison Research data cited by AdWave reports 47 million monthly U.S. podcast listeners in 2015.
According to Edison Research data cited by AdWave, 47% of Americans ages 12+ had listened to a podcast in the last month.
facts.quote: 47% of Americans ages 12+ had listened to a podcast in the last month

facts.fact: AdWave's guide states that most beginner podcast content recommends consistency and broad promotion but does not clearly address whether a small business should prioritize guest-led networking, local SEO, or direct-response CTAs.
facts.quote: Most beginner content recommends consistency and broad promotion, but it does not clearly address whether a small business should prioritize guest-led networking, local SEO, or direct-response CTAs.

facts.fact: AdWave recommends that a small business owner be able to state a podcast's purpose in one sentence of the form 'This show will help my business get known for ___ among ___.'
facts.quote: Start a podcast only if you can answer one sentence clearly: “This show will help my business get known for ___ among ___.”

facts.fact: AdWave recommends a USB microphone as the core of an affordable small-business podcast setup because it is plug-and-play.
facts.quote: USB microphone: Plug-and-play is the point. A USB mic removes setup complexity and gets you recording fast.

facts.fact: AdWave names Audacity, GarageBand, and Descript as recording/editing software options for small-business podcasts.
facts.quote: Audacity and GarageBand cover the basics for many owners. Descript is useful if you want a more text-based editing workflow.

facts.fact: The page recommends validating a podcast concept with at least 10 episode ideas before launch, citing Buzzsprout's launch guidance as the basis for this workflow.
facts.quote: validate the concept with at least 10 episode ideas

facts.fact: The page describes a five-step infographic illustrating the process for publishing and distributing a business podcast episode.
facts.quote: A five-step infographic illustrating the professional process for publishing and distributing a business podcast episode.

facts.fact: The page says Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and other directories read a podcast's RSS feed to display its episodes.
facts.quote: Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and other directories read that feed and display your episodes.
